title.scan_frame: Scan the barcode on the frame

description.scan_velopass: Point your camera at the QR code. Hold the camera about 15 cm from the Frame-ID.
description.scan_frame: Point your camera at the barcode sticker with the frame number on your bike's frame.
description.manual: The code is printed vertically on the right side of the Frame-ID sticker on your bike's frame.
description.result_velopass: We recognised the QR code. Confirm to start the transfer.
description.result_frame: We recognised the frame number. Double-check it before you search.

permission.blocked_body: You have denied or blocked camera access for this site.

desktop_chrome.headline: Turn the camera back on in Chrome / Edge:
steps: Click the lock icon on the left of the address bar.

desktop_firefox.headline: Turn the camera back on in Firefox:
steps: Click the lock icon on the left of the address bar.
Next to 'Camera', click the cross to remove the block.
Reload this page and choose 'Allow' when prompted.

desktop_safari.headline: Turn the camera back on in Safari:

ios_safari.headline: Turn the camera back on iPhone/iPad (Safari):
steps: Tap 'aA' on the left of the address bar → Website Settings.
Set Camera to 'Allow'. (Or: Settings app → Safari → Camera → Ask/Allow.)

ios_chrome.headline: Turn the camera back on iPhone/iPad:
steps: Open the Settings app → choose your browser (Chrome / Edge / Firefox).

android_chrome.headline: Turn the camera back on in Chrome for Android:
steps: Tap the lock icon on the left of the address bar → Permissions.

android_firefox.headline: Turn the camera back on in Firefox for Android:
steps: Tap the lock icon on the left of the address bar → Edit site settings.

in_app.headline: Open this page in your real browser
steps: Tap the menu icon in the top right.
Choose 'Open in Safari' (iPhone) or 'Open in Chrome' (Android).
Allow the camera there and scan again.
in_app.note: In-app browsers from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and similar often don't remember camera permission, or block it altogether.

default.headline: Re-enable camera access in your browser
steps: Open the site settings (usually via the lock icon in the address bar).

error.not_found_msg: No camera found on this device.
error.in_use_msg: The camera is already in use by another app or tab.
error.unsupported: This browser doesn't support the camera API.
error.body_in_use: Close other apps or tabs using the camera (e.g. Zoom, Teams, Photo Booth) and try again.
error.body_not_found: We couldn't find a camera on this device. Enter the Frame-ID code manually.
error.body_constraints: Your camera doesn't support the requested settings. Enter the code manually.
error.body_generic: {{message}} Try again or enter the code manually.
